/* Smile On homepage styles. Based on the Al Satwa location page system (WPCode snippet 6838), scoped to this page via this inline style block. Brand: teal #2D9CA9 -> violet #6656C4 */
body{--sodc-teal:#2D9CA9;--sodc-violet:#6656C4;--sodc-ink:#1d2733;--sodc-muted:#55606d;--sodc-line:#e7ecf1}

settings.editor: From Invisalign and dental implants to teeth whitening and root canal care, we correct, repair and restore healthier smiles. Every treatment is carried out by a dentist who specialises in it, in one comfortable clinic on 2nd December Street. Call us today, we're open every day, 9am to 9pm.

settings.editor:
Meet your specialists

settings.title_text: Dental pain or a broken tooth?

settings.title: A One-Stop Dental Clinic for the Whole Family

settings.editor:
Smile On Dental Clinic LLC is a one-stop place for all your dental concerns. Established in 2021 by Dr. Arun Devarajan and Dr. Jeffrey Manuel, we offer a wide range of dental care in a well-equipped clinic, with a team of experienced doctors who truly care about your dental health.

We combine the latest cosmetic techniques with proven treatment plans to correct and restore your smile. Every plan is personalised, from preventive and pediatric care to cosmetic and specialist treatment, so you get the right care from the right dentist.
Whatever your smile needs, there's a specialist for it under one roof. Tap a treatment to learn more, or call us and we'll point you to the right dentist.

settings.description_text: Metal, ceramic, Damon and lingual braces with a specialist orthodontist.
Clear aligners for teens and adults from a certified Invisalign provider.
Self-ligating braces with fewer adjustments.
Replace missing teeth, from a single implant to All-on-4.
Leave with a temporary tooth on the day, when the implant is stable.
Save an infected tooth with a specialist endodontist.
Smile makeovers planned around your face and your bite.
In-clinic and Zoom whitening for a brighter smile.
Natural-looking veneers that reshape and brighten.
Restore broken or missing teeth with lasting results.
Periodontist-led care for bleeding or receding gums.
Gentle visits with a specialist pediatric dentist.
A full exam, with X-rays only when they're needed.
Scaling and polishing from AED 150.
A complete plan to restore comfort, function and looks.
Handled by our oral and maxillofacial surgeon.
Includes an X-ray and scaling for children. Ideal for a first visit.
A professional clean to remove tartar and surface stains.
Clean and brighten your smile in one visit.

settings.editor: Offers are subject to availability and a dentist's assessment.

settings.title: Why Patients Across Dubai Choose Smile On

settings.editor: Patient comfort and quality care come first. We combine experienced specialists with modern dental technology for an accurate diagnosis, safe procedures and reliable results.

settings.description_text: An orthodontist, endodontist, oral surgeon, prosthodontist, periodontist and pediatric dentist all work here. No referral across town.
A 5.0 rating on Google from 333 reviews by patients across Dubai.
Severe pain, a broken tooth or swelling? We keep slots open so you can usually be seen the day you call.
Digital X-rays and modern equipment for an accurate diagnosis, safe procedures and reliable results.
On 2nd December Street, easy to reach from Jumeirah, Bur Dubai, Karama and across Dubai.
Your options and what each one costs are explained before anything starts. No upselling and no manufactured urgency.

tabs.tab_title: What dental services does Smile On Dental Clinic offer?
tabs.tab_content: We offer a full range of dental care under one roof, including general and preventive dentistry, cosmetic treatments like teeth whitening and veneers, orthodontics including Invisalign and braces, dental implants, root canal treatment, gum treatments and pediatric dentistry for children. See all dental services.

tabs.tab_title: Where is Smile On Dental Clinic located?
tabs.tab_content: Our clinic is in Al Satwa, Dubai, at Unit 213, AMKM Investment Building, 2nd December Street. We're easy to reach from Jumeirah, Bur Dubai and other nearby areas.
We're open every day of the week, from 9am to 9pm.

tabs.tab_title: Do you accept insurance or offer payment plans?
tabs.tab_content: We work with a range of insurance providers and also offer flexible payment options for treatments not covered by insurance. Contact our team before your visit and we'll confirm your coverage.

tabs.tab_title: Can I get a same-day emergency dental appointment?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We keep slots open for urgent dental concerns such as severe pain, broken teeth or swelling, so you can usually be seen the same day you call +971 55 896 1826.
Yes. Our specialist pediatric dentist, Dr. Minu Mumtaz O.V., sees babies, children and teens. Ask about our free pediatric consultation.

tabs.tab_title: How do I book an appointment?
tabs.tab_content: The quickest way is to call us on +971 55 896 1826, every day from 9am to 9pm. You can also send a WhatsApp message or book online, and our team will confirm your appointment and send you a reminder.

tabs.tab_title: What languages do your doctors speak?
tabs.tab_content: Our team is multilingual and comfortable treating patients in English along with several other languages. Let our front desk know your preference when you book and we'll do our best to accommodate you.

settings.title: Ready for a Healthier, Brighter Smile?

settings.editor: Call us now for an appointment or advice. Specialists in-house, same-day urgent slots and a 5.0 Google rating. Open every day, 9am to 9pm.
